nodes.label: User Account (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Verified email + MFA-for-privileged before sensitive actions

nodes.label: Consent (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Purpose-limited, active consent required for minor participation

nodes.label: Participant (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Verified guardian/institution + consent before Active

nodes.label: Institution (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Verified institution required for bulk/analytics; tenancy scope

nodes.label: Competition (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Ordered, time-gated lifecycle; structure frozen after results

nodes.label: Application (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: No submit without consent; no accept without eligibility (+payment if paid)

nodes.label: Performance (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Not judged until scanned-clean & moderation-cleared; pseudonymized to jury

nodes.label: Jury Panel (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Panel scope bounds assignments

nodes.label: Judge Assignment (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Unit of judging work linking jury member to performance for a round; blocked on conflict of interest

nodes.label: Scorecard (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Complete rubric scored; locked & immutable after window close

nodes.label: Score Aggregation (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Only valid, non-recused, locked scorecards contribute

nodes.label: Result (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Published only after judging finalized; immutable except governed correction

nodes.label: Ranking (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Ties resolved before finalization

nodes.label: Diploma (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Unique verification code per diploma; revoked & reissued on upheld dispute

nodes.label: Billing Account (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Single financial identity per payer

nodes.label: Order (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Total = line items − discounts, one currency; paid before entitlement

nodes.label: Invoice (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Immutable once issued; corrected by void + reissue, never edited

nodes.label: Payment (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Money captured against an order; refunds are separate compensating actions

nodes.label: Notification (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Sent only on permitted channels

nodes.label: Audit Log Entry (Aggregate Root)
nodes.rationale: Immutable, append-only; never updated/deleted outside retention policy

nodes.label: Clean Architecture
nodes.rationale: Dependencies point inward; domain knows nothing about Django/DRF/PostgreSQL/HTTP. Enables testability and infrastructure replaceability.

nodes.rationale: Single-responsibility, open/closed, Liskov, interface-segregation, dependency-inversion applied across modules.

nodes.label: Domain-Driven Design
nodes.rationale: System decomposed into bounded contexts with a shared ubiquitous language.

nodes.label: API First
nodes.rationale: Every capability exposed via a versioned, contract-first OpenAPI; SPA is just one consumer.

nodes.label: Mobile First
nodes.rationale: UI designed smallest-viewport-first; performance budgets assume mid-range mobile.

nodes.label: Security by Design
nodes.rationale: Threat modeling, least privilege, secure defaults, defense in depth from day one.

nodes.label: Privacy by Design
nodes.rationale: Data minimization, purpose limitation, consent tracking, minor-data protection are structural.

nodes.label: Event-Driven Integration
nodes.rationale: State changes emit domain events; cross-context reactions handled asynchronously via Redis/Celery.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: Single deployable Django app partitioned into strict bounded-context modules; DDD boundaries without microservice ops overhead.

nodes.label: Transactional Outbox
nodes.rationale: Domain events persisted in the same transaction as state changes, relayed to Redis — at-least-once delivery without dual-write inconsistency.

nodes.label: Schema-per-Context
nodes.rationale: Each bounded context owns its tables under a dedicated PostgreSQL schema; cross-schema FKs avoided, references by ID.

nodes.label: RBAC + Scoping
nodes.rationale: Role-based access control refined with scope/tenancy and light ABAC; deny by default, least privilege.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.rationale: Short-lived access token + rotating refresh token; reuse detection invalidates the token family.
